verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is Bland's self-description as an enterprise platform for "regulated" phone workflows (bland-probe-1) and its statement that each enterprise customer runs on dedicated, isolated infrastructure (bland-docs-36). Together these offer only glancing support for running regulated workloads, and neither names a specific compliance program. Missing for 10: any documentation of HIPAA compliance or BAA availability, SOC 2 attestation, data-residency or region-selection options, and independent corroboration.
